name: Whole-head 150-channel LTS-SQUID magnetoencephalography in a magnetically shielded room with a liquid-helium helmet dewar kept at 4.2 K by a 1.4 W pulse-tube reliquefier
plain_name: Record brain magnetic signals with helium-cooled SQUID sensors
description: MEG of spontaneous brain activity: low-Tc SQUID gradiometers in the vacuum space of a 90 L liquid-helium helmet dewar inside a magnetically shielded room; evaporated helium is reliquefied continuously by a Cryomech PT415RM (1.4 W at 4.2 K), giving 3.5 fT/rtHz white noise.
keywords: Record brain magnetic signals with helium-cooled SQUID sensors

sources.citation: Lee Y H, Kwon H, Yu K K, Kim J M, Lee S K, Kim M-Y, Kim K. Low-noise magnetoencephalography system cooled by a continuously operating reliquefier. Supercond. Sci. Technol. 30 (2017) 084003. DOI 10.1088/1361-6668/aa718e

requirements.rationale: The SQUID gradiometers are cooled by the liquid-helium helmet at 4.2 K.
The sensors are cooled by direct thermal contact with a liquid-helium bath that the reliquefier refills.
Femtotesla brain fields are recorded inside a magnetically shielded room (MSR).
Reported reliquefier capacity (1.4 W at 4.2 K), stated to be more than sufficient for the 13-14 L/day boil-off; informative, not a hard minimum.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
